Heard the learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opp. party no. 2,learned A.G.A.
and perused the record.

sentences.text: It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicants that it is purely a civil dispute, wherein a suit of specific performance of the opp. party no.2 is pending before the competent civil court.
A suit has also been filed from the applicants' side.
No suit has been filed for cancellation of sale deed in favour of the applicant no. 3, hence, the prayer is made accordingly.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the opp. party no. 2 prayed that the applicant no. 2 has executed a sale deed of which he was not the owner in favour of applicant no. 3.

From the perusal of the record, it is found that the FIR was lodged by the opp. party no. 2 challenging the sale deed in favour of the applicant no. 3 executed by the applicant no. 2 being a fraudulent document.
Admittedly, no suit has been filed for cancellation of this sale deed in the competent court.
The applicant no. 1 is said to be the witness of this sale deed.
This court cannot embark upon an inquiry regarding the genuineness of the impugned sale deed.
The matter is of civil nature.

. 2 can get a relief from the competent court and only if the competent court declares the document to be a forged/ fraudulent, then only the opp.party no. 2 would have a right to file a criminal suit.

The entire proceedings of criminal case no. 865 of 2023, State Vs. Amar Singh and others, as well as cognizance/ summoning order dated 12.7.2023 passed by learned Judicial Magistrate, Konch u/s 420, 506, 421 and 120-B I.P.C., an case crime no. 249 of 2022, police station Kotwali Konch District Jalaun are quashed.
